Task 931's research report (reports/01) asserts a closed seven-anchor enumeration with a cross-check grep 'returns exactly the occurrences at lines 109, 908, 1047 and 1075 ... The enumeration is closed.' A live re-grep at plan time falsifies the site list: HistoryMorphism.lean:589 also occurs at line 910 (the Section 15.3 'The two missing pieces, named.' paragraph), which additionally carries a stale **missing** claim now contradicted by the amended line 110. The report acknowledges line 910 elsewhere but concludes 'no independent edit is made at line 910', whereas the dispatch and task 927's Finding (3) both state its replacement text IS the Risks amendment. The plan therefore carries EIGHT anchors, not seven, and records the divergence explicitly.

The sole file_scope target (specs/archive/901_two_sided_reynolds_engine_paper_proof/reports/01_two-sided-reynolds-engine-paper-proof.md) lives under specs/archive/, which .gitignore line 94 excludes wholesale; git ls-files/git log confirm it has never been tracked. Substituting: per-edit Edit-tool provenance (each edit targeted one exact old_string) plus before/after grep counts plus a manual cp-based diff snapshot, in place of git diff hunk counts.
